description: Sunbird Wing: briefing, radio and outcome.

briefing: Two Gyptian family ships are holding in {system} while they mend a drive. Raiders are coming. Keep the families alive and drive the raiders off.
Guard two Gyptian family ships in {system}. Fly with the Sunbird wing and see off the raiders.
success: The families are safe and the raiders are gone. {client} pays {captain}, and the families send bread.
Raiders driven off. {client} pays, and the Gyptians remember your name.
failure: A family ship was lost. {client} pays nothing and the fleet holds a leaving song for it.
The raiders got through. The Gyptians are quiet for a long time.
radio-families: Family ship: Sunbirds, we're dead in the water and full of children. Please be quick.
Family ship: Drive's in pieces. We're not going anywhere. Neither are the kids.
radio-kit: Kit Farrow, on your wing. Welcome to the Gyptians, Captain.
Kit: Sunbirds up. Stay with me.
radio-raiders: Kit: Raiders, right side! Three and a gunship. The gunship wants the families.
Kit: Here they come. Turn inside them. Sunbirds always win the turn.

description: The Lost Page: briefing, radio and outcome.

briefing: Three archive pods drift in {system}. One holds a stolen page of the Reckoning of the Road. Search them all, then get clear before the collectors arrive.
Search the drifting archive pods in {system} for the lost page. Hold close to each. Collectors are on their way.
success: The page is found and you're clear. {client} pays {captain}. Old Dov weeps, briefly and with dignity.
failure: The collectors have the page. {client} pays nothing.
The page is lost again. Dov says it will turn up. It took sixty years last time.
radio-pods: Kit: Three pods ahead. Hold close to each so the scanner can read inside.
Dov (relayed): Gently, Captain. Paper doesn't like vacuum, and it likes guns even less.
radio-collectors: Kit: Frigate behind us, the {target}, and fighters. The collectors have come for their page.
Collector frigate {target}: That page was bought and paid for. Hand it over and you can go.

description: By Order of the Gate Authority: briefing, radio and outcome.

briefing: Gate wardens from {enemy} mean to impound a column of Gyptian family ships in {system} and seize the Reckoning. Get the column away.
Escort the Gyptian column out of {system} before {enemy}'s wardens can board it.
success: The column is clear and the Reckoning is safe. {client} pays {captain} and files a protest.
The wardens go home empty-handed. {client} pays.
failure: The column was boarded and the Reckoning seized. {client} pays nothing.
The family ships are impounded. Somewhere a clerk is reading the Reckoning of the Road, and understanding none of it.
radio-column: Sabra: Column moving. Stay with us, Captain. Don't let them board.
Family ship: We've got the Reckoning aboard. If they want it, they'll have to catch us.
radio-wardens: Warden frigate {warden}: Gyptian vessels, heave to for inspection by order of the Gate Authority.
Kit: Warden frigate ahead, and interceptors. They're polite. They're also armed.
radio-boarders: Kit: Boarding gunships on the left! They're going for the family ships!
Kit: That's the boarding party. Stop them before they clamp on.

description: Homecoming Holds: briefing, radio and outcome.

briefing: {enemy} has come for the Gyptian ring station {base}. Hold until the Synod arrives, and keep the {base} alive.
Defend the {base} against {enemy}. The Synod is on its way. Hold until it gets here.
success: The {base} holds and the Synod has arrived. {client} pays {captain}. The Gyptians sing all night.
The ring stands. {client} pays, and the Gyptians write your name in the margin of the Reckoning.
failure: The {base} is lost. {client} pays nothing. The Gyptians scatter, and the road gets longer.
The ring station fell. The Reckoning survives in a safe, and the families say they will build another.
radio-station: Sabra: All Sunbirds up. Steadfasts on the ring. Captain, you're with Kit.
Dov: The children are in the hub. Keep the hub in one piece, please.
radio-first: Kit: Fighters ahead, and gunships for the ring.
Kit: Here they come. Concord colours, no warning.
radio-line: Kit: Concord cruiser on the left, the {target}. Gunships going for the {base}.
Sabra: That's their cruiser. Keep its gunships off the ring.
radio-last: Kit: Interceptors behind! Last push, I hope.
Kit: More of them. Stay on my wing.
radio-synod: Synod cruiser: Lantern Synod ships arriving. This station is under the Synod's protection. All Concord vessels stand down.
Kit: Synod ships! They came. Sabra, they actually came.
